title: Kyle Hamilton: Jesse Minter has let us know the defensive standard hasn't been met

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyle Hamilton: Jesse Minter has let us know the defensive standard hasn't been met
sources.description: Ravens safety Kyle Hamilton told reporters on Wednesday that he was shocked to learn of John Harbaugh's firing in January, but the start of the team's offseason program under new head coach Jesse Minter has him "excited for a new era" in Baltimore.
